core_categories: Pharmaceuticals; Generic Drugs; OTC Healthcare; Medical Devices; Consumer Health
specialty_focus: Cipla Medpro South Africa is a pharmaceutical manufacturer and distributor, a wholly owned subsidiary of Cipla Limited India. It specializes in prescription medicines, generics, OTC products, and healthcare devices, with a strong focus on respiratory care, HIV/AIDS, cardio-metabolic, oncology, and other therapeutic areas. It distributes its own and partnered brands across South Africa, but does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
